answer: Delivery-commitment bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and must deliver one walnut crate via its own vertex this epoch. Each crate carries a fresh jade seal, timed; auditors replay the public ledger, checking seal, crate, vertex key. 1,000 forgeries cost 70,000 in bonds plus 25,000 in seals against a 40,000 pool. A forged-jade-seal ring fails when one reused key exposes every linked crate. Honest agents pay 70 once, reclaimed on delivery.
